segments.name: North America
segments.description: Produces flat, long and tubular steel products for automotive, energy, construction, packaging and appliances customers in North America.
segments.evidence: North America produces flat, long and tubular products.

segments.name: Brazil
segments.description: Produces flat, long and tubular steel for construction, power generation, agribusiness, automotive and household appliance customers.
segments.evidence: Brazil produces flat, long and tubular products.

segments.name: Europe
segments.description: Produces flat and long steel products for automotive, general industry and packaging customers.
segments.evidence: Europe produces flat and long products.

segments.name: India and JVs
segments.description: Holds the Company's interests in joint ventures, associates and other investments, viewed as a high growth vector.
segments.evidence: India and JVs includes all of the Company's interests in joint ventures, associates and other investments.

segments.name: Sustainable Solutions
segments.description: Niche capital-light businesses supporting climate action plus an in-house trading and distribution arm for long and flat products.
segments.evidence: Sustainable Solutions is composed of a number of niche capital-light businesses that play an important role in supporting climate action (including renewables, special projects and construction business) and which ArcelorMittal believes have high growth potential.

segments.name: Mining
segments.description: Operates seaborne iron ore mining in Canada and Liberia, supplying steel operations and selling mineral products to third parties.
segments.evidence: Mining comprises the Company's seaborne iron ore mining operations in Canada and Liberia.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay ArcelorMittal for flat, long and tubular steel products and for iron ore and mineral products sold to third parties.
revenueModel.evidence: It provides the Company's steel operations with high quality and low-cost iron ore reserves and also sells mineral products to third parties.

changes.text: In June 2025, ArcelorMittal acquired control of ArcelorMittal Calvert, its former joint venture with NSC.
changes.evidence: In June 2025, ArcelorMittal acquired control of ArcelorMittal Calvert, its former joint venture with NSC (see note 2.2.4 to the consolidated financial statements).
